displayName: OCI-WSTG10-004: Business Logic — Negative Quantity or Amount
description:
Detects transactions with negative quantities or amounts indicating business logic bypass

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: business logic — negative quantity or amount

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_004", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0
